prompt:
# genui_gen_v3

You are an GenUICraft generator. Convert the response text into valid GenUICraft JSON using ONLY the schemas and catalog provided below (local copies). Do NOT reference any external URLs.

Response:
Assumptions:
- Standard video playback controls (play/pause, progress bar, volume, fullscreen toggle) are present in the control bar.
- The 'Next Episode' button appears as an overlay, typically towards the end of the video or when paused.
- The 'Skip Intro' button is a temporary, contextual overlay that appears at the specified timestamp.

Video Player Dashboard Design:

Summary:
The dashboard provides a clean, intuitive interface for streaming content, focusing on the video playback while offering essential controls and contextual overlays for an enhanced user experience.

Dashboard Layout Description:

1.  Main Video Area:
    *   Occupies the majority of the screen, displaying the video 'Nature Documentary: The Deep Sea'.
    *   Current resolution: 1080p (indicated subtly, perhaps in settings or a small overlay on hover).
    *   Subtitles: Enabled (English), displayed at the bottom of the video frame.

2.  Control Bar (Bottom of the player, appears on hover/interaction):
    *   Playback Controls (Left):
        *   Play/Pause button
        *   Rewind/Fast Forward buttons (e.g., 10 seconds)
    *   Progress Bar (Center):
        *   Displays current time, total duration, and allows scrubbing through the video.
        *   Current Position: e.g., 02:30 / 45:00
    *   Volume Control (Right-Center):
        *   Volume slider and mute toggle.
    *   Information & Settings (Right):
        *   Subtitles/CC icon (indicating English is active).
        *   Settings Gear icon: Opens a menu for quality selection (e.g., 1080p, 720p, Auto), audio tracks, and other player preferences.
        *   Fullscreen Toggle button.

3.  Overlay Elements:
    *   Skip Intro Button:
        *   Appearance: A rectangular button overlay, e.g., "Skip Intro" or "Skip (0:15)"
        *   Placement: Typically appears centrally or bottom-right of the video frame.
        *   Context: Appears at the 02:15 mark of the video, remaining visible for a few seconds before fading out if not clicked.
    *   Next Episode Overlay Button:
        *   Appearance: A prominent button, e.g., "Next Episode: Journey to the Abyss"
        *   Placement: Can appear centrally, or in the bottom-right corner of the video frame.
        *   Context: Typically appears in the last 15-30 seconds of the current video, or when the video is paused.

Icons:
- Play: https://example.com/icons/play.svg
- Pause: https://example.com/icons/pause.svg
- Settings Gear: https://example.com/icons/settings.svg
- Subtitles/CC: https://example.com/icons/subtitles.svg
- Fullscreen: https://example.com/icons/fullscreen.svg
- Volume: https://example.com/icons/volume.svg
- Skip Intro: https://example.com/icons/skip-forward.svg (often represented by a skip-forward icon)
- Next Episode: https://example.com/icons/next-episode.svg (often represented by a next track icon)

Images:
- Video Player Dashboard Example: https://example.com/ui-assets/video-player-dashboard-mockup.jpg

Rules:
- Output ONLY a valid GenUICraft server-to-client message list (array of messages) that conforms to the schema below.
- Use ONLY component definitions from the catalog below.
- Messages must follow the v0.9 schema types: createSurface, updateComponents, updateDataModel, deleteSurface.
- Include a createSurface message with a catalogId before any updateComponents.
- Use only local asset URLs that start with '/'. No remote URLs.
- No markdown, no extra text.

Additional strict requirements:
- Use message types: createSurface, updateComponents, updateDataModel, deleteSurface.
- Set version to v0.9.
- Include createSurface before updates.
- In updateComponents, include exactly one root component with id 'root'.
- Output ONLY a JSON array of messages.
